Metal Culture is an arts organisation, providing a platform for artistic laboratory spaces promoting cross-art collaborations and projects to affect the built environment, people, communities and philosophies. According to its mission statement, it "champions the right for artists, creatives and other curious people to follow hunches, explore dreams and probe problems through creativity to inspire positive change".
